description: Deployment configuration for mod-organizations. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-organizations revision 14)

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-organizations container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-organizations container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-organizations container in MiB

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Initial Java metaspace size, threshold at which the first metaspace garbage collection runs (-XX:MetaspaceSize).

deployment.description: The module is stateless: no local persistence

kong.description: Kong route timeouts in milliseconds for mod-organizations.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the module process. -Dhttp.port=8082 moves RMB off its default port 8081, which the Eureka sidecar uses; it must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL. Heap sizing comes from the java block.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of the Log4j2 configuration file, read directly by Log4j from the environment (equivalent to -Dlog4j.configurationFile)

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container, in MB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation for the sidecar container, in MB

java.name: UseZGC
java.description: Use ZGC low-pause collector; preferred for a proxy-shaped workload where tail latency matters more than throughput

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the module this sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-organizations backend container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-organizations module deployed alongside this sidecar
